Its our first day exploring Ile du Coine. We first decided to go to decided to explore the coconut plantations. They had been abandoned long ago and had quickly become overgrown. July 17th 2028

We have now covered the whole of Ile du Coine and have also looked over nearby Ile Fouquet and Ile Poule. We are now planning to explore the Danger Shoals which are nearby. Due to my inexperience with diving, I have returned to Diego Garcia to consolidate with the rest of the team. I also thought it would be a good opportunity to recharge, gather our findings and plan where we go from here. It also allows me rest and maybe spend some time with Anna. July 26th 2028

We are now moving onto the next stretch of islands. These include Petite Soeur, Grande Soeur and Ile Verte. The Dutch and German teams will accompany my team as we search these new areas. We were able to successfully document the flora and fauna which we found on the islands. We were heading back to the boat when I saw Anna and Hans walking ahead of me. Hans reach down and took hold of Anna's hand. She didn't retract her hand. Something about it made me feel uneasy, but I couldn't put my finger on it.

August 9th 2028

We have now moved to the North part of the atoll. We first went to Moresby Island. It is named after the British hydrographer who once sailed and documented the Chagos. His findings have been important to understanding of the archipelago, however his records are now outdated. For example, Ile Verte was originally just a small sandbank but has now become a small island covered in vegetation. We then continued on to Ile Longue and Ile Parasol. There we were able to collect further data on the Sooty Tern. We have found that there are over 60,000 breeding pairs now on the two islands, an increase of around 7-8000 pairs since the last survey of the islands in 2004.

August 30th 2028

Today we visited Ile Yeye and Ile Bois Mangue. Ile Bois Mangue translates as Mango Wood Island. The whole island is covered in mango trees. We were able to spot several Lesser Noddies feasting on the ripe mangoes that had fallen to the floor. The island is home to around 14,000 Noddies. Once we had recorded our findings we headed back to Diego Garcia. I was quite tired after the boat journey back to HQ, so I went for a nap in my room. When I got up I decided to check my email. 'This is exactly what is needed to reconnect with her' I thought to myself. I headed to the cafeteria where she normally hangs out. The scene I saw made my stomach turn and my heart sink. It wasn't just a friendly peck to welcome in the new year, but one filled with months of tension and passion, at least on Anna's end. But I had been oblivious, unaware of her true feelings. The avoidance, the lack of interaction all went under my radar. I had basically unintentionally rejected her for a pile of dodo bones. No wonder she wasn't talking to me much. I'd blown it before it had any chance to blossom. This realisation had come too late. I liked Anna, a lot.But now there is nothing I can do about it, I feel helpless.
